purpose.summary: Reads a sequential stock/inventory master file (CADESTOQ.DAT) and prints a formatted stock report (RELESTOQ) with item detail lines showing code, name, quantity, unit cost, and total cost, plus a summary page with total quantity, average price, and total price.
purpose.domain: inventory/stock management, likely an academic exercise

verdict.notes: Program was written by a student (Fabio Costa) at FATEC-SP (a Brazilian technical college) in October 2015. The misspelling 'OMMITED' instead of 'OMITTED' and the academic context confirm student work. No COPY statements, no CALL statements, and no SQL/CICS. The large block of blank lines at the end is typical of student submissions. Dialect confidence is medium because the exact compiler is not stated, but the PC-oriented file handling and Brazilian academic context suggest GnuCOBOL or a Micro Focus personal edition.
